name: Joe Biden
summary: A center-left Democrat who backed unions, gun control, abortion rights and same-sex marriage, built on the Affordable Care Act, and signed large industrial and climate investments while favoring alliances and international institutions.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Supports building on the Affordable Care Act with a public option rather than single-payer; extended ACA subsidies in the Inflation Reduction Act.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: 'Raise the federal minimum wage because every worker has the right to earn a decent living!' (2024).

markets-allocate-better.rationale: No recorded position found in the sources consulted.

public-ownership.rationale: No recorded position found in the sources consulted.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Supports reversing Republican tax cuts for the wealthy and corporations; opposed the Bush tax cuts. 'No billionaire should pay a lower tax rate than a teacher, a sanitation worker, a nurse!' (2024).

unions-good.rationale: Cosponsored the Employee Free Choice Act, holds an 85% lifetime AFL-CIO rating, and in 2023 became the first sitting president to join a picket line (UAW). 'Unions built the middle class!' (2024).

property-fundamental.rationale: No recorded position found in the sources consulted.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Strongly supported the Dodd-Frank financial regulation law.

cut-welfare.rationale: 'If anyone here tries to cut Social Security or Medicare or raise the retirement age I will stop them!' (2024); opposes privatizing or means-testing Social Security.

worker-ownership.rationale: No recorded position found in the sources consulted.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Voted for the 2001 USA PATRIOT Act but also voted to limit wiretapping under it.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Called marijuana 'a gateway drug' in 2010; by 2019-2020 backed decriminalization and state-level legalization, and in 2022 pardoned federal simple-possession convictions.

state-harmful.rationale: No recorded position found in the sources consulted.

limit-guns.rationale: Authored the 1994 assault weapons ban, supports universal background checks, and signed the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act.

empower-police-military.rationale: 'I do not support defunding police' (2020); proposed doubling federal community-policing funding.

legalize-sex-work.rationale: No recorded position found in the sources consulted.

decide-locally.rationale: No recorded position found in the sources consulted.

rehabilitation.rationale: Opposes the death penalty since 2019 and commuted 37 of 40 federal death sentences in 2024; backed the 2010 Fair Sentencing Act.

traditional-family.rationale: No recorded position found in the sources consulted.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Endorsed same-sex marriage in 2012 and signed the Respect for Marriage Act in 2022.

abortion-legal.rationale: 'I will restore Roe v. Wade as the law of the land again!' (2024); reversed his support for the Hyde Amendment in 2019.

more-religion-public.rationale: No recorded position found in the sources consulted.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Supports affirmative action; 'The dream of justice for all will be deferred no longer.'

gender-social-construct.rationale: No recorded position found in the sources consulted.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: No recorded position found in the sources consulted.

gradual-change.rationale: No recorded position found in the sources consulted.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Pledged to restore DACA and raise the refugee ceiling to 125,000, and supports an earned path to citizenship; halted border-wall funding in 2021.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Pledged to restore U.S. membership in UN bodies such as UNESCO and the WHO: 'We will repair our alliances and engage with the world once again.'

free-trade.rationale: Voted for NAFTA and backed the Trans-Pacific Partnership, but voted against several trade deals over weak labor and environmental protections.

nation-first.rationale: 'Ukraine can stop Putin if we stand with Ukraine and provide the weapons it needs to defend itself'; pledged to restore U.S. alliances and international engagement.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Favored deploying about 2,500 U.S. troops to stop the violence in Darfur, though he initially opposed the 2011 Libya intervention.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Rejoined the Paris Agreement, set a net-zero by 2050 goal and signed the largest U.S. climate investment; 'A cry for survival comes from the planet itself.'
